questions.scenario: Employee exits mid-payroll month after slips drafted
questions.proposed_resolution: Status Exited removes from next run; current month run if already posted stays immutable

questions.scenario: Duplicate PAN across two Active employees
questions.proposed_resolution: Warn on save; block payroll for both until resolved

questions.scenario: Invite accepted creates employee while manual add already used same email
questions.proposed_resolution: Merge onto existing id if email match; else reject invite accept

questions.scenario: Attendance marked Present on Approved leave day
questions.proposed_resolution: Attendance Leave wins; Present overwrite requires confirm

questions.scenario: Hard delete employee with historical payroll slips
questions.proposed_resolution: Reject hard delete; force Exited then Archived
